_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Summary Report of Data Records Management Activity
summary: Documents contractors' effort toward contract objectives, summarizing assistance provided to worldwide Aerial Port Data records functions, including RFI-specific training per AFI 24-605V2.
use_relationship:
The Summary Report of Data Records Management Activity documents the contractors' effort towards achieving contract objectives. The Summary Report documents all assistance provided to any worldwide Aerial Port Data records functions, to include requests for information (RFIs)-specific training provided as outlined in Air Force Instruction (AFI) 24-605, Air Transportation Operations, Volume 2 (V2), Section 4B. (Copies of AFI 24-605V2 can be obtained online at: https://static.epublishing.af.mil/production/1/af_a4/publication/afi24-605v2/afi24-605v2.pdf.)
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Summary Report of Data Records Management Activity shall be in Microsoft Excel format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Summary Report of Data Records Management Activity shall contain the following:

children.title: Report of Data Records Transportation services, which shall include a description of the following:
Any assistance provided pertaining to Personally Identifiable Information (PII) requirements
Any assistance provided pertaining to aerial port workload reporting
Any assistance provided pertaining to Transportation Working Capital Fund (TWCF) and Non-TWCF manifest register completion
Any assistance provided pertaining to creating and maintaining consolidated flight packages
Any assistance provided pertaining to airlift ground handling records disposition
Any assistance provided pertaining to deployed aerial port forces records disposition
Any assistance provided pertaining to small terminal record keeping
Any assistance provided pertaining to transportation discrepancy reporting
Any assistance provided pertaining to data records functions for Global Air Transportation Execution System (GATES) database data integrity and management
Cumulative totals of the number of the activities identified above in paragraph 3 that occurred throughout the current fiscal year.
